11:Account-bound Cloud commands live under `mcpjam cloud`. Local MCP testing stays at the top level (`mcpjam server`, `mcpjam oaut
h login`, …). Credential flags `--api-key` / `--api-url` / `--api-header` are declared on `mcpjam cloud` and work before or after
descendants. Hosted `readiness` stays at the root and still takes leaf `--api-key`. See [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/cli/migration.md).
335:Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger: self-issue an ID-JAG, redeem it at the target authorization server (RFC 7523), and
call the MCP server with the resulting access token. See the [XAA Debugger guide](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa.md) for the tru
st setup, registration strategies, and CI usage.
569:An unknown ID, or an ID or flag for a suite the run leaves out, is a usage error (exit code `2`) before anything runs.
597:| `--server <name=url>` | | Bind a target server to an HTTP(S) URL. Repeatable. Split on the first `=`; duplicate or unknown n
ames are usage errors. |
611:Global `--timeout` bounds each setup operation and MCP request, not the whole run. Exit codes: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` usa
ge/unsupported/import/policy, `3` credentials, `4` setup/billing/artifact, `5` inconclusive or interrupted — see [Exit codes](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#exit-codes).
643:`--host` is a usage error rather than a silent precedence rule.
948:> the deployment, not by your account: a self-hosted or older MCPJam whose
1186:Launch a goal run. **Spends model credits** — fans out into `targets × iterations` chat sessions.
1193:| `--expected-sponsored <n>` | No | How many of this launch's conversations you expect to be sponsored (paid from MCPJam's pe
r-user allowance instead of your organization's credits). If the actual split differs, the launch is refused with a `409` and noth
ing is created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |
1225:Each pending request holds one of the account's five concurrent-connection slots for up to an hour. If `connect` reports `ACT
IVE_REQUEST_LIMIT`, the error details include the ids of the open requests — cancel the abandoned ones with `connect-cancel` to fr
ee slots.
1279:## `cloud server-accounts` commands
1281:The accounts a saved server signs in with for hosted runs, addressed by account ID or name. Every command takes `--server <id
-or-name>` (required) and `--project <id-or-name>`. No command prints a token. See [Server accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/refer
ence/public-api.md#server-accounts) for what an upload stores and how runs choose an account.
1283:### `cloud server-accounts list`
1285:List the server's accounts: each one's ID, name, whether runs use it by default, whether it needs reconnecting, and whether i
t is for hosted runs only.
1287:### `cloud server-accounts show`
1289:Show one account.
1293:| `--account <id-or-name>` | Yes | Account ID or name |
1295:### `cloud server-accounts set`
1297:Upload an access token to an account. A name no account has creates the account; otherwise its token is replaced and its ID s
tays. Accounts uploaded this way are for hosted runs only. Nothing checks who a token belongs to: the name is your own label.
1303:| `--account <id-or-name>` | Yes | Account ID or name |
1312:./sign-in-test-user | mcpjam cloud server-accounts set --server my-server \
1313: --account test-automation-1 --client-id my-client --access-token -
1316:### `cloud server-accounts rename`
1318:Rename an account.
1322:| `--account <id-or-name>` | Yes | Account ID or name |
1325:### `cloud server-accounts default`
1327:Make an account the default. Runs with no saved account choice sign in as the default, so set it before you start a run, and
don't start runs that need different defaults at the same time.
1331:| `--account <id-or-name>` | Yes | Account ID or name |
1333:### `cloud server-accounts delete`
1335:Delete an account and its stored token, and ask the token's issuer to revoke it where the issuer supports that. The default a
ccount can't be deleted while other accounts exist: make another account the default first.
1339:| `--account <id-or-name>` | Yes | Account ID or name |
1405:Grade a server locally — from your machine, against the URL you supply. No account required. Results are printed to stdout an
d never uploaded.
1441:Grade a saved server against a publisher's directory as the platform reaches it — through the saved server row and the author
ize exchange. This is the hosted half of `readiness check`: it answers a different question (what the platform sees, not what your
machine sees), can optionally run a model for experience observations (included with MCPJam — no credits are consumed), and leave
s a persistent record.
1461:| `--ai-observations` | No | Add optional model observations. **Consumes MCPJam credits.** |
1477:| `--ai-observations` | No | Add optional model observations. **Consumes MCPJam credits.** |
1490:| `--claim <feature>` | Declare a feature the server offers, so the report shows it as claimed. One of `lazy-authentication`
or `enterprise-managed-auth`. Repeat to claim several (at most 10). An unknown value is a usage error. |
